# Native Source Reference and Muscle-Path Conventions

This provisional F07f chapter covers issue #11962 under #11791 and epic
#11784. The read-only observer records source geometry and concrete muscle
options at a declared native state. It does not repair anatomy, set control
parameters, establish physiological limits, or qualify full-body dynamics.
The exact calculation source is
`tour_matching/native_reference_conventions.py`; the existing
`native_constraint_state.py` supplies the model/runtime/state observation.

## Source, State, and Frame Contract

`ReferenceStateDeclaration` binds a named reference and provenance to the
exact entrypoint XML SHA-256 and initialized native clock (this API supports
the 0 s initial clock). `post-init-system` observes the state returned by
`initSystem()`. **OpenSim performs native assembly during `initSystem()`**;
serialized coordinate defaults may differ from achieved coordinates. Both are
recorded, along with model `assembly_accuracy` and constraint residuals.
`complete-named-state` then supplies every native named continuous state value
and rejects ignored or incomplete assignments, without an additional assembly.
It retains the initialized clock and native defaults for other state/options.
Neither mode certifies the native numerical/discrete restart state. The source
is loaded from an owned XML copy; original bytes are checked afterward.
`audit_source_reference` invokes no additional assembly, muscle equilibrium,
forward integration, or force override. Native realization updates caches in
its owned State only.

The caller declares an absolute reference `PhysicalFrame` path. With its
ground transform $(R_0,p_0)$, each frame's reported position and rotation are

$$p_i^{(0)}=R_0^T(p_i-p_0),\qquad R_i^{(0)}=R_0^TR_i.$$

All positions and muscle paths use metres; rotations are proper native
direction-cosine matrices. Joint records retain concrete class, parent/child
frame paths, coordinate paths and source serialization hashes. Coupler records
retain explicit dependent/independent coordinate paths, function class and
current enforcement. Coordinate values, locks, prescription, constraints,
modeling options and registered values remain in the embedded native audit.
Equal path strings across two sources never prove equal axis meaning, joint
limits, anatomy, or state preparation.

## Muscle and Wrap Observations

Every registered native muscle contributes concrete law, current geometry-path
length, optimal fiber length, tendon slack length, pennation at optimal length,
maximum isometric force, native activation/tendon-compliance options, source
serialization hash, declared path-point frame/local and ground locations,
current routed path-point class/identity/activity and native wrap-curve samples,
and wrap-object frame/translation/rotation/class. Native wrap-curve samples
retain their API-native coordinates; they are not silently interpreted as
ground or reference-frame coordinates. The
DeGrooteFregly2016 law additionally exposes passive-fiber-disable and fiber
damping flags. The source XML and loaded native model hashes bind the
observation. A current routed point can move with state or wrap choice; it is
not inferred from fixed origin/insertion XML. These observations never call
passive readiness or substitute for force-law calibration.

`NativeReferenceCorrespondence` explicitly names selected left/right frame,
joint, coordinate and muscle paths; binds both full observation digests; and
records a declared proper rigid transform plus provenance. The transform means
right-reference coordinates $=R_{RL}$ times left-reference coordinates plus
$t_{RL}$. No map is generated from matching names. For a mapped frame pair the
diagnostic displacement is

$$\Delta p=p_R-(R_{RL}p_L+t_{RL}),$$

and the orientation difference is the principal SO(3) angle between
$R_i^{(R)}$ and $R_{RL}R_i^{(L)}$; for a mapped muscle pair the length difference
is $\Delta L=L_R-L_L$. A one-to-one mapping
with a nonexistent path, changed source/state observation, or non-rotation is
rejected. These are coordinate diagnostics in a declared registration, not
proof of anatomical correspondence; the result always says
`not-qualified-for-anatomy`. Joint and coordinate pairs validate that named
paths exist but do not assert physical equality or compute an unqualified
parameter difference. The returned joint and coordinate pairs are explicitly
marked `not_compared`: a Cartesian frame registration does not establish scalar
coordinate sign, offset, axis, range or coupler equivalence.

## Native Checks and Limits

An actual OpenSim 4.6 SliderJoint fixture yields a 0.2 m body and muscle-path
displacement; an explicitly restored 0.3 m named state changes the observation
without changing source defaults. A coupled fixture has inconsistent serialized
defaults; native initialization assembles them and the audit retains both.
Source SHA, clock, incomplete-state, stale observation, missing correspondence
and improper rotation regressions reject. A rotated weld with unchanged origin
produces a 0.5 rad orientation difference rather than false zero frame error.
An actual DeGrooteFregly2016 fixture preserves a declared cylinder wrap,
its engaged native wrap-curve samples, passive-fiber-disable, rigid tendon and
0.02 fiber-damping setting. A MovingPathPoint fixture changes native local and
ground position across two declared states; a ConditionalPathPoint switches
activity and is omitted from the current route when inactive. No source
bytes or model law are modified by either audit.

Bounded post-initSystem diagnostics observed all 520 muscles, 249 frames, 80
joints and 76 wraps in the unchanged Wilkinson generic source (SHA-256
`a55c64341680551fb5a41be254bdfdb3b2be0ac789336ea44902b22fc9a83913`).
The public Pose2Sim author source (SHA-256
`53f84b9552b1c5eceee3768fa820b75bd675daeea473f918cffeb5c6337f0c13`)
yielded 318 muscles, 111 frames, 30 joints and 89 wraps. An explicitly named
candidate mapping in the two native pelvis coordinate frames showed about
43 mm shorter IL_L4_r and MF_m5_laminar_r paths in Pose2Sim; the pelvis
frames have not been anatomically registered. The alternative source has
different ancestry, coupling and upper-limb coverage and is not a substitute
for the endpoint model. Full machine-readable observations and mapping live
in the local F07f staging receipt; the raw public source XML is not committed.

The SHA-256 of entrypoint XML does not close transitive resource identity.
The source models emitted missing visual-mesh warnings when loaded from the
owned temporary XML. This audit depends on native model/path readback, not
visual render geometry, and retains the warning as a resource-closure gap.
Native runtime extension hashes, loaded serialization and observer hash are
recorded; they do not certify a donor release, capture subject, contact/grip
law, physiology, calibrated marker frame, or complete restart. Full F07/F08
qualification remains open.

Run the actual native fixture in the pinned OpenSim environment:

```text
python -m pytest -q -o addopts= tests/opensim/test_native_reference_conventions.py
```
